ideas.pitch: An AI-powered hospital workflow and patient triage optimization engine for emergency departments.

ideas.title: MediFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive operational bottleneck in urban Indian hospitals (hospital workflows), aligning directly with the incubator judges' preference for scalable real-world economic impact rather than superficial apps.

ideas.pitch: EV charging station load balancer and renewable energy integration dashboard for commercial parking facilities.
